source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check Chassis information and detail information, then compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_CPUSLED, reads only Manufacturer, ProductName and AssetTag with insecure curl, and omits the source-required WebUI/IPMI comparison and CPU-sled identity proof.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly keeps AssetTag separate from SerialNumber and adds complete mapped evidence, but leaves finite sled and asset-record inputs as an unnecessary decision gate.

old_problem: AssetTag is commonly administratively assigned and can be blank, mutable or non-unique, so it cannot by itself prove the physical CPU sled. The old review identified the mapping and semantics problem but retained Pending instead of expressing sled topology, FRU device, AssetTag policy and reference data as runtime prerequisites.
disposition_reason: First bind the exact physical CPU sled through approved chassis/topology relationships and an immutable or stable hardware identity, then select its IPMI/UI/API records, keep AssetTag, serial number, service tag and UUID as separate typed fields, and compare the full FRU record with the approved manufacturing and asset authorities. All operations are deterministic reads after the Project package is supplied.
decision_basis: XLSX row 955, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 956 were directly reviewed; the next pending identity was verified as Functionality row 956 / variant 409b78afbb342907.

The DeepSeek projection uniquely substitutes AssetTag for SerialNumber compared with adjacent FRU cases. Those properties have different semantics and must remain separately authoritative; equality is not presumed.

IPMI FRU Product/Board areas can contain serial, part and asset-tag fields, while DMTF Chassis/Assembly has distinct AssetTag and SerialNumber properties. The Project policy determines whether AssetTag is required, mutable, blankable or unique.
The source still requires complete actual WebUI detail and `ipmitool fru print`; a three-property Redfish response cannot establish the sled's complete identity or parity.

ED-02, ED-08, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve distinct source coverage and evidence; ED-33 through ED-38 allow safe parameterization while rejecting guessed endpoints, partial field substitution and hidden asset semantics.

test_case.test_name: Validate CPU-sled FRU identity with distinct asset-tag and serial semantics
test_case.purpose: Verify the Project-defined physical CPU sled maps uniquely to FRU_CPUSLED, all applicable FRU data decode correctly, and its immutable manufacturing identity plus administratively governed AssetTag agree with their respective authorities and the actual WebUI/IPMI/mapped API evidence without conflating AssetTag, serial, service tag or UUID.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/chassis identity and approved CPU-sled physical topology/slot relationship with a durable hardware identifier independent of AssetTag
Complete enumerated IPMI FRU device map and approved CPUSLED device ID/interface/channel/bridge/address
Mapped Redfish Chassis/Assembly or approved OEM CPUSLED resource and actual WebUI Inventory and LEDs sled row/detail field mapping
Applicable CPU-sled FRU Board/Product/Chassis/MultiRecord/custom-field layout and encoding, padding, blank, unsupported and freshness rules
Authoritative manufacturing/BOM record for immutable fields plus separate asset-management authority defining AssetTag format, expected value, uniqueness, mutability and allowed blank behavior
Trusted TLS, protected read-only credentials, stable-token redaction and protected artifact storage for serial, asset, UUID and service identifiers
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify immutable target and physical CPU-sled association, enumerate all IPMI FRU devices through the approved protected interface/channel/bridge and select CPUSLED only by the approved durable map. Run only `ipmitool ... fru print <CPUSLED-FRU-ID>` and retain complete output, exit code and decode/checksum diagnostics. Discover the mapped standard Chassis/Assembly or approved OEM resource from Redfish links and capture the actual rendered BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs CPUSLED row/detail. Decode every applicable FRU area and create distinct columns for Board/Product Serial Number, Asset Tag, Service Tag and UUID; never alias or copy values between them. Preserve raw values, apply only approved normalization, compare immutable fields to the manufacturing/BOM authority and AssetTag only to the asset-management authority, then reconcile each supported field across IPMI, WebUI and API. Repeat only read fingerprints; do not edit asset tags or FRU, clear logs, refresh inventory, reset, reboot or power-cycle.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one physical CPU sled maps to the selected CPUSLED IPMI device and UI/API record by durable non-AssetTag identity. All applicable areas decode without reported structural/checksum errors. Every required immutable field exactly matches the manufacturing authority, and AssetTag independently matches the approved asset record or its explicitly permitted blank state; serial, service tag and UUID remain distinct. The complete IPMI, actual WebUI and mapped API representations reconcile under documented rules, with no duplicate/ambiguous sled and no state change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires unique physical sled binding independent of AssetTag, complete `ipmitool fru print`, actual rendered WebUI evidence, successful applicable-area decoding and separate exact comparisons to manufacturing and asset authorities. Matching Manufacturer/ProductName/AssetTag alone, treating AssetTag as serial, accepting a blank without policy or selecting a guessed URI/device cannot pass. Wrong/duplicate sled, conflicting stable identity, parser/checksum failure, missing required field, unauthorized blank/duplicate AssetTag or unexplained source/reference mismatch is FAIL. Missing sled map or asset policy is NOT READY, not Pending; N/A needs authoritative applicability evidence.
safety_gate: Use only certificate-verified/protected read sessions and approved IPMI routing; do not expose credentials or accept insecure-TLS evidence.
Bind the physical CPU sled with topology plus stable hardware identity before evaluating AssetTag; never use AssetTag alone to select the sled.
Treat AssetTag, serial number, service tag and UUID as different fields with separate authorities; no heuristic copying, equality assumption or silent blank normalization is allowed.
Allow only FRU enumeration and `fru print`; prohibit FRU/AssetTag write or edit, raw storage writes, inventory refresh, log clear, reset, reboot and power operations.
Retain complete raw IPMI/API data and actual rendered WebUI visual evidence before normalization/redaction, preserving stable tokens and protected originals.
Stop on duplicate AssetTag, ambiguous sled mapping, stale data, decode/checksum failure or authority conflict; do not automatically select or query another FRU as a retry.
expected_evidence: Immutable target and physical CPU-sled map with durable hardware association independent of AssetTag, plus complete enumerated IPMI FRU list
Timestamped complete `ipmitool fru print <CPUSLED-FRU-ID>` output with channel/bridge, return code, decoder/checksum status and protected hash
Discovered Redfish/OEM resource chain and complete CPUSLED artifact with schema/firmware and certificate validation
Actual rendered WebUI Inventory and LEDs CPUSLED table/detail visual evidence with stable sled token and all required fields
Field matrix with separate AssetTag, serial, service tag and UUID columns, raw/normalized values, individual authority and exact outcome
Pre/post fingerprints, preserved SEL/audit evidence, no-write/no-clear/no-reset/no-power proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On ambiguous sled mapping, duplicate AssetTag, parser/checksum error or source/authority mismatch, stop, preserve and redact evidence and obtain the approved topology or asset policy. Do not edit AssetTag/FRU, clear logs, reset BMC, reboot, power-cycle or automatically retry against a different FRU.

source_conflict.reason: The Master consistently targets CPU-sled FRU correctness and explicit IPMI comparison. The prior three-field proposal's AssetTag ambiguity is an implementation deficiency, not a source contradiction.

blocked.reason: The CPU-sled and distinct asset/manufacturing comparison are clear. Physical mapping and AssetTag policy are bounded Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Physical CPU-sled mapping; CPUSLED IPMI/API/UI identities; applicable FRU fields; manufacturing/BOM record; distinct AssetTag authority and policy; normalization, freshness, trust and redaction.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ-ONLY FRU_CPUSLED REVIEW ONLY; NO IPMI, REDFISH, WEBUI, ASSET OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
